blurb: At the age of 65, when most people are thinking about retirement, Charleston, WV, native Margaret Drennen convinced her beloved husband, Judge William M. Drennen, to purchase 10 acres of land in Shepherdstown. Upon purchase, she marveled at the sheer beauty of the land and wondered if she should purchase the “whole darn thing.” She again contacted her good friend Henry Shepherd and bought the remaining 250 acres.
